selection.scope: dev shadow report-head only; no independent test or physical validation

detector.VISW: UNAVAILABLE: no residual cache or pre-resampling ESS

scope.path: consecutive saved estimated loaded_transport poses, joined by linear XY/shortest yaw interpolation; no claim they are a planned or physically swept path
scope.continuous_bound: exact center-segment to wall-rectangle Euclidean distance minus circumscribed footprint radius 0.25m; also fixed-yaw swept convex polygon bound, subdividing rotations so each subsegment loses at most 0.25mm rotational error
scope.uncertainty: trace-only conservative translation bound 3*std_xy plus yaw displacement 2*0.25*sin(min(pi,3*std_yaw)/2), use max endpoint sigmas; envelope between reports explicitly assumed; subtract tracking0.010+map0.005m
scope.contract: geometric clearance >=0.060m, and uncertainty-adjusted continuous lower bound>=0; overlaps and unavailable covariance reported separately; not safety proof

route_audit.limitation: Audit is of estimated shadow polylines. Planned route and actual swept path are not interchangeable; no safety/physical passage claim.

posthoc_diagnostics.scope: post-selection diagnostics only; no refitting or threshold changes
